parents.title: For grown-ups
parents.dropNote: A new pack arrives every week at this time, by this device’s clock. Changing it only moves the packs still to come.
parents.previewOn: Preview: show all cards (they don’t count as collected), and let packs arrive before their facts are written. Packs opened in preview stay; use “Start over” afterwards.
parents.resetConfirm: Start {name} over? Their cards, packs and badges will be cleared, and Series 1, Week 1 arrives again.
parents.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? Their cards, packs and badges will be removed from this device.
parents.backupNote: Saves every explorer’s cards, packs, badges and settings on this device in one file. Keep it somewhere private, such as iCloud Drive. Field Notes pages have their own backup in Field Notes.
parents.backupFailed: The backup couldn’t be made. Please try again.
parents.restoreNote: Restoring only adds what isn’t on this device yet. It never replaces or removes anything.
parents.restoreNothing: Nothing to restore: everything in that file is already on this device.
parents.restoreBad: That isn’t a WildFile backup file.
parents.restoreFailed: The backup couldn’t be restored. Nothing was changed.
account.title: Family account
account.intro: Optional. A grown-up signs in with their email; kids never need an account. The app works just the same without one.
account.syncs: Coming next: each explorer’s packs, cards, badges and settings kept the same on all your family’s devices. Height, weight, age, home country, quiz scores and Field Notes always stay on this device.
account.sentTo: We emailed a sign-in code to {email}.
account.codeHint: {n} digits. Or open the link in the email on this device.
account.signOutConfirm: Sign out on this device? Your explorers and their progress stay on this device.
account.needsSignIn: Your sign-in has ended. Please sign in again ({email}).
account.err.offline: No internet connection. Please try again when you’re online.
account.err.rate-limit: Too many emails or tries. Please wait a minute and try again.
account.err.bad-code: That code didn’t work. Check it, or send a new one.
account.err.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
link.title: Sign in on this device?
link.text: This link signs a grown-up in to the family account on this device.
link.failed: That link didn’t work: it may have been used already, or it has expired. You can send a new one under For grown-ups → Family account.
badge.secretHint: Keep exploring to find secret badges!
badge.secretTap: Tap the card to see what you found
badge.rub: Rub the medal to make it shine!
badge.flick: Flick it up to your badges
notes.title: Field Notes
notes.empty: Your field notebook is empty. Start a page to draw, write and stick in photos.
notes.emptyCard: No pages about {name} yet. Start one and draw what you notice!
notes.penOnlyHint: Pen only: fingers turn pages. Tap to draw with a finger too.
notes.fingerHint: Drawing with a finger. Tap so only a pen draws.
notes.penFound: Pen found: now only the pen draws, so your hand can rest on the page. Tap “Pen only” to draw with a finger again.
notes.noStamps: Collect some cards first: their animals become your stamps.
notes.exportPage: Save this page as a picture
notes.deleteConfirm: Delete this page? It can’t be brought back.
notes.backupNote: Your notes stay on this device. A backup is a zip file you can keep somewhere safe and restore later.
notes.exportFailed: That didn’t work. Please try again.
notes.importFailed: That file isn’t a Field Notes backup.
